newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 355,000 to 366,000 head versus 367,000 a week ago and 350,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 25,000 to 60,000 head versus 72,000 a week ago and 156,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 120,000 to 126,000 head versus 115,000 a week ago and 125,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 25,000 to 30,000 head versus 32,000 a week ago and 35,000 a year ago.
